slip.label: 简版吊带裙（c_cfg55 那种）
slip.prompt: thin-strap yellow slip dress, deep V neckline with a small gold clasp at the bust, satin fabric with soft sheen, long flowing skirt, white fluffy fur coat, off-shoulder, slipping off both shoulders, her shoulders and collarbones are bare, coat sleeves hanging loose and empty, coat resting on her upper arms
slip.negative: military coat, gold trim, striped panel, ruffled shorts, lace-up boots, evening gown, ball gown, wedding dress, long gown, coat worn on both shoulders, coat buttoned up, coat sleeves on her arms
slip.note: 简版吊带裙 + 毛绒外套半脱；胸像/特写最稳。肩线露得多，别和军事风大衣同框。

casual_knit.label: 针织日常（大毛衣 + 百褶裙）
casual_knit.prompt: cream oversized knit cardigan, soft ribbed wool texture, one sleeve slipping off her shoulder, white camisole underneath, grey pleated wool skirt, bare legs with white ankle socks, brown leather loafers
casual_knit.negative: military coat, gold trim, striped panel, white fur coat, ball gown, high heels, long gown
casual_knit.note: 针织日常：大毛衣 + 百褶裙。毛衣容易吞掉肩线，靠 one sleeve slipping off 这句救回来。

school.label: 水手服（夏季）
school.prompt: white sailor blouse with navy collar, red neckerchief, navy pleated skirt, dark knee socks, brown loafers, sailor collar with white stripes
school.negative: military coat, white fur coat, slip dress, ball gown, hoodie, jeans
school.note: 夏季水手服。原来 @NEG_BASE 里默认禁 school uniform，2026-10-31 已从全局限定里移除，现在可以直接用；如果不想要校服串到别的图，就在那套图的负向里单独加 school uniform。

gala.label: 晚礼服（藏青丝绒）
gala.prompt: deep navy velvet evening gown, floor-length skirt with a subtle train, thin straps over bare shoulders, satin gloves reaching the elbow, small pearl earrings, hair in a low chignon
gala.negative: military coat, white fur coat, yellow slip dress, shorts, lace-up boots, knit cardigan

terms: gown resting low on the shoulders

gala.note: 藏青丝绒长裙 + 缎面长手套；正式场合。拖尾会吃构图，建议配 @CAM_FULL。

raincoat.label: 雨衣（透明风衣）
raincoat.prompt: translucent plastic raincoat, hood down around her neck, white long-sleeve top underneath, dark jeans, rubber rain boots, water droplets on the coat surface
raincoat.negative: white fur coat, ball gown, high heels, military coat, straw hat
raincoat.note: 透明雨衣；雨天/街景。塑料反光容易脏，负向压 plastic sheen / glare。

gym.label: 运动装（卫衣 + 束脚裤）
gym.prompt: grey hooded sweatshirt, black jogger pants, white running shoes, towel around her neck, hair tied in a high ponytail
gym.negative: overcoat, ball gown, pleated skirt, high heels, military uniform
gym.note: 卫衣 + 束脚裤；动作场景。马尾和毛巾是识别点，别配高跟鞋。

winter.label: 冬装（驼色大衣 + 红围巾）
winter.prompt: camel wool overcoat, long red knit scarf wrapped twice, black turtleneck, dark trousers, leather ankle boots, knit mittens
winter.negative: white fur coat, slip dress, ball gown, sandals
winter.note: 驼色大衣 + 红围巾；冬季。围巾绕两圈容易挡下半张脸，特写时改成 wrapped once。

yukata.label: 浴衣（夏祭）
yukata.prompt: white yukata with blue morning-glory pattern, wide navy obi sash, wooden geta sandals, hair in a low bun with a hairpin, small cloth pouch in her hand
yukata.negative: western clothes, jeans, leather boots, overcoat, ball gown

terms: collar opened wide showing the neck

yukata.note: 白底蓝牵牛花浴衣；夏祭。腰带位置和下摆长度决定像不像，配屋顶/街道场景。

smock.label: 画室罩衫（亚麻）
smock.prompt: cream linen artist smock, paint stains on the hem, sleeves rolled to the elbow, black camisole underneath, dark trousers, paintbrush tucked behind her ear
smock.negative: ball gown, white fur coat, school uniform, high heels

terms: apron ties loose at the back

smock.note: 亚麻画室罩衫；工作场景。袖子卷到肘 + 下摆颜料痕是灵魂，别配礼服鞋。

maid.label: 女仆装（黑白）
maid.note: 黑白女仆裙 + 白围裙 + 头饰。围裙和裙摆的层次是识别点；负向要压军装和礼服，不然会串味。
maid.prompt: black and white maid dress, white apron with lace trim, short puffed sleeves, white frilled headband, black thigh-high stockings, mary jane shoes, neat bow at the collar
maid.negative: military coat, white fur coat, ball gown, evening gown, jeans, high heels

swimsuit.label: 连体泳装（深蓝）
swimsuit.note: 深蓝连体泳装 + 沙滩巾。配海边/泳池场景；别塞进咖啡馆这种室内场景。
swimsuit.prompt: navy one-piece swimsuit, racerback straps, high-cut legs, a striped beach towel over her shoulders, wet hair, barefoot on the sand
swimsuit.negative: military coat, ball gown, school uniform, leather boots, jeans

hanfu.label: 汉服襦裙（浅青）
hanfu.note: 浅青交领襦裙 + 披帛。系带位置和裙摆长度写清楚，不然容易变成和服。
hanfu.prompt: pale celadon hanfu with crossed collar, long flowing skirt with a wide hem, silk sash tied at the waist, wide sleeves, a sheer shawl draped over her arms, hair in a half-up bun with a jade pin
hanfu.negative: kimono, yukata, military coat, ball gown, jeans, leather boots

suit.label: 西装（炭灰套装）
suit.note: 炭灰西装 + 白衬衫 + 铅笔裙。肩线要硬；负向压毛绒和礼服，否则会软成针织。
suit.prompt: charcoal grey tailored blazer, white dress shirt, slim pencil skirt, black leather pumps, thin silver necklace, hair in a low ponytail, one button left open on the blazer
suit.negative: white fur coat, ball gown, maid dress, hoodie, sneakers

santa.label: 圣诞装（红白）
santa.note: 红白圣诞短裙 + 毛边。红色容易溢出，负向加 oversaturated red；季节限定，别常态用。
santa.prompt: red santa-style mini dress, white fur trim on the hem and cuffs, black belt with a gold buckle, red santa hat with a white pompom, black tights, black ankle boots
santa.negative: ball gown, military coat, oversaturated red, orange tone, fur coat

idol.label: 偶像舞台装
idol.note: 亮片短上衣 + 百褶短裙 + 耳返。舞台光下最出彩；亮片写太多会糊成一团。
idol.prompt: shiny sequined crop top, pleated mini skirt with silver trim, white thigh-high boots, in-ear monitor and small headset mic, glittery hair accessories, stage lighting sparkle
idol.negative: military coat, ball gown, school uniform, jeans, sneakers

loungewear.label: 居家（大号卫衣+短裤）
loungewear.note: 大号卫衣盖住短裤下摆、露出腿。居家感靠 oversize 和 bare legs；别套外套。
loungewear.prompt: oversized grey sweatshirt, shorts barely visible under the hem, bare legs, white socks, messy loose hair, sitting on the sofa
loungewear.negative: military coat, ball gown, high heels, jeans, fur coat

cheongsam.label: 旗袍（墨绿）
cheongsam.note: 墨绿丝质旗袍 + 盘扣 + 开衩。开衩高度要写清楚（knee-length slit），否则容易变浴袍。
cheongsam.prompt: dark green silk cheongsam, mandarin collar with frog buttons, gold piping along the edges, knee-length side slit, black embroidered flats, hair in a low bun with a hairpin
cheongsam.negative: kimono, yukata, ball gown, military coat, jeans, sneakers

overalls.label: 工装背带裤（画家）
overalls.note: 牛仔背带裤 + 白T。画室日常；背带扣、口袋和膝盖颜料痕是识别点。
overalls.prompt: denim overalls with metal buckles, white t-shirt underneath, paint stains on the knees, canvas sneakers, hair tied back loosely
overalls.negative: ball gown, military coat, maid dress, high heels

sundress.label: 夏日白棉长裙
sundress.note: 白棉吊带长裙 + 草帽。白布容易过曝，负向加 blown highlights；和 slip 的区别是哑光无光泽。
sundress.prompt: white cotton sundress with thin straps, knee-length flared skirt, matte cotton texture, a wide straw hat, woven sandals, light breeze lifting the hem
sundress.negative: satin sheen, military coat, ball gown, high heels, fur coat, blown highlights

pajama.label: 睡衣（居家）
pajama.note: 棉质睡衣：宽松上衣 + 条纹裤 + 赤脚。居家/睡前场景；别配外套和鞋。
pajama.prompt: soft cotton pajama set, loose button-up top, striped pajama pants, bare feet, messy hair
pajama.negative: military coat, ball gown, school uniform, leather boots, high heels

school_bare.label: 水手服·赤足
school_bare.prompt: white sailor blouse with navy collar, red neckerchief, navy pleated skirt, sailor collar with white stripes, bare feet, barefoot, visible toes, bare legs
school_bare.negative: military coat, white fur coat, slip dress, ball gown, hoodie, jeans, socks, knee socks, loafers, shoes
school_bare.note: 校服赤足版：把鞋袜从正向里删掉并写进负向，避免负向和套装打架。

yukata_bare.label: 浴衣·赤足
yukata_bare.prompt: white yukata with blue morning-glory pattern, wide navy obi sash, hair in a low bun with a hairpin, small cloth pouch in her hand, bare feet, barefoot, visible toes
yukata_bare.negative: western clothes, jeans, leather boots, overcoat, ball gown, wooden geta sandals, sandals

terms: collar opened wide showing the neck

yukata_bare.note: 浴衣赤足版：去掉木屐，适合温泉/室内/走廊。

cardigan_set.label: 针织开衫·日常
cardigan_set.prompt: oversized beige knit cardigan, white camisole underneath, navy pleated skirt, brown loafers, soft ribbed cuffs
cardigan_set.negative: ball gown, military coat, swimsuit, maid outfit
cardigan_set.note: 日常开衫；配 @SET_ROOM / @SET_CAFE 最稳，适合半身和坐姿。

hoodie_casual.label: 卫衣·休闲
hoodie_casual.prompt: oversized grey hoodie, drawstrings hanging, black bike shorts, white sneakers, loose fit
hoodie_casual.negative: ball gown, maid outfit, sailor uniform, high heels
hoodie_casual.note: 街头/居家休闲；卫衣容易吃掉身材线条，想要比例就配 @CAM_FULL。

sundress_floral.label: 碎花吊带裙
sundress_floral.prompt: white sundress with small blue floral print, thin spaghetti straps, knee-length flowing skirt, white sandals, light cotton fabric
sundress_floral.negative: ball gown, winter coat, leather boots, hoodie
sundress_floral.note: 夏季日常；配 @SET_GARDEN_PEONY / @SET_BEACH 和木漏れ日最好看。

lab_coat.label: 白大褂·研究员
lab_coat.prompt: white lab coat, light blue button-up shirt, black pencil skirt, id badge on a lanyard, pen in the chest pocket
lab_coat.negative: ball gown, maid outfit, swimsuit, sailor uniform
lab_coat.note: 职业题材；配 @SET_LAB? 没有就用 @SET_ARTROOM / @SET_LIBRARY + 冷白灯。

sailor_winter.label: 水手服·冬
sailor_winter.prompt: navy sailor uniform with long sleeves, grey wool overcoat over it, red neckerchief, navy pleated skirt, dark knee socks, brown loafers
sailor_winter.negative: ball gown, swimsuit, maid outfit, sundress
sailor_winter.note: 冬季校服；大衣会增加体积，配 @CAM_FULL 或 @CAM_MEDIUM。

denim_set.label: 牛仔外套·街头
denim_set.prompt: light blue denim jacket, plain white t-shirt, denim shorts, white sneakers, rolled-up sleeves
denim_set.negative: ball gown, maid outfit, sailor uniform, winter coat
denim_set.note: 街头休闲；配 @SET_STREET? 没有就用 @SET_MARKET / @SET_CORRIDOR。

school_m.label: 男学生制服（立领）
school_m.prompt: dark navy gakuran jacket, stand collar, gold buttons, black trousers, leather shoes
school_m.negative: pleated skirt, sailor collar, dress, high heels
school_m.note: 男学生制服：立领 + 金扣，配 @SINGLE_M 用。别和女生水手服同挂。

suit_m.label: 西装（三件套）
suit_m.prompt: charcoal three-piece suit, white dress shirt, silk tie, tailored trousers, leather dress shoes
suit_m.note: 西装：三件套最稳；领带和 @HAND_M_TIE 一起用效果最好。

casual_m.label: 毛衣 + 直筒裤
casual_m.prompt: cream knit sweater, straight-leg jeans, white sneakers
casual_m.note: 日常便服：毛衣+直筒裤，适合咖啡馆/街道。

gym_m.label: 运动短装
gym_m.prompt: black tank top, navy track shorts, running shoes
gym_m.note: 运动短装：配 @BODY_MALE_ATHLETIC 用，别加外套。

hoodie_m.label: 连帽卫衣 + 束脚裤
hoodie_m.prompt: grey hoodie, hood down, jogger pants, sneakers
hoodie_m.note: 卫衣：帽子放下更稳，戴帽子容易压脸。

coat_m.label: 大衣 + 围巾
coat_m.prompt: long wool coat, scarf, turtleneck sweater, dark trousers, leather boots
coat_m.note: 冬季大衣：围巾只绕一圈，绕两圈会挡住下巴。

yukata_m.label: 男浴衣（藏青）
yukata_m.prompt: indigo men's yukata, obi belt at the waist, wooden geta
yukata_m.note: 男浴衣：领口是左压右（男款），和女款和服不能混。

uniform_m.label: 职场衬衫
uniform_m.prompt: light blue dress shirt, sleeves rolled up, dark slacks, leather belt
uniform_m.note: 职场衬衫：袖子挽起（@DRAPE_M_CUFF）更有生活感。

jersey_m.label: 运动队服
jersey_m.prompt: striped baseball jersey, matching shorts, cleats
jersey_m.note: 运动队服：条纹最显眼；配 @POSE_M_ARMS_AKIMBO 或运动场景。

tuxedo_m.label: 燕尾礼服
tuxedo_m.prompt: black tailcoat, white wing-collar shirt, black bow tie, pleated trousers, patent leather shoes
tuxedo_m.note: 燕尾礼服：正式度最高，配 @ID_MALE_TIGHT 做定妆图。

leather_m.label: 皮夹克
leather_m.prompt: black leather jacket, silver zipper, dark jeans, boots
leather_m.note: 皮夹克：配 @HAIR_M_POMPADOUR 或 @HAIR_M_MULLET 最摇滚。

vest_m.label: 毛衣马甲（学院）
vest_m.prompt: knit sweater vest, white shirt underneath, pleated trousers, loafers
vest_m.note: 学院马甲：衬衫领要露出来，配 @FACE_MALE_YOUNG。

jinbei_m.label: 甚平（夏季和服）
jinbei_m.prompt: indigo jinbei, short kimono sleeves, sash at the waist, wooden sandals
jinbei_m.note: 甚平：夏祭/居家，比浴衣随意；领口左压右（男款）。

hakama_m.label: 和服 + 袴
hakama_m.prompt: dark kimono, hakama trousers, white haori, tabi socks
hakama_m.note: 和服袴：剑道/神社，动作别太随意，配 @POSE_M_KNEEL 很有仪式感。

swim_m.label: 泳裤（运动）
swim_m.prompt: black swim trunks, drawstring waist, bare chest
swim_m.note: 泳裤：配 @BODY_MALE_ATHLETIC；赤膊是正常的，别加 @NEG_MALE_SOFTBODY 之外的负向。

apron_m.label: 围裙（咖啡店）
apron_m.prompt: white apron over a dark shirt, apron strings at the back, rolled sleeves
apron_m.note: 围裙：咖啡店/酒保，配 @ROLE_BAKER 或厨房场景。

tracksuit_m.label: 运动套装
tracksuit_m.prompt: navy tracksuit, white side stripes, zip-up jacket, running shoes
tracksuit_m.note: 运动套装：侧条纹最出效果，配 @POSE_M_WALK 有动感。

raincoat_m.label: 雨衣
raincoat_m.prompt: yellow raincoat, hood up, rubber boots
raincoat_m.note: 雨衣：雨天/街景。塑料反光容易脏，负向压 plastic sheen。

labcoat_m.label: 白大褂
labcoat_m.prompt: white lab coat, dark trousers, name badge, leather shoes
labcoat_m.note: 白大褂：医生/研究员，配 @SET_OFFICE 或实验室场景。

winter_m.label: 羽绒冬装
winter_m.prompt: puffer jacket, knit scarf, wool trousers, snow boots
winter_m.note: 羽绒冬装：体积大，远景要留出人物比例；围巾只绕一圈。

sunbloom.label: 花束礼服（黄裙 + 白外套）
sunbloom.prompt: pale yellow sleeveless pinafore dress with black piping, white coat with gold trim, black ribbon bow at the collar, black tights, white lace-up boots with gold laces, sunflower motif
sunbloom.negative: sneakers, bare legs, hoodie, pleated skirt, blue dress
parts: 淡黄无袖连衣裙（黑滚边）
sunbloom.note: 澪的原初设计稿：黄裙 + 白外套 + 黑丝袜 + 白靴。立绘模板的标准造型。
